description: http-wake v1 (handoffs.md#http-wake-v1). Draft-07 schemas plus machine-readable tables. Claim and mint steps name case-session v1 definitions as case-session#<name>.

FEATURE_DISABLED.when: §1: ENVOI_HTTP_WAKE_V1 is off, on a wake route or the key set.

WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_INVALID.when: §3: the body is not exactly its schema.

WAKE_URL_REJECTED.when: §3.1, §4.1, §4.2: the URL breaks a rule. reason names the first rule it breaks, in x-url-checks order.

WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND.when: §3: the subscription is unknown or belongs to another installation or agent; identical in every case.

WAKE_CHALLENGE_INVALID.when: §3.3: the challenge does not match. Nothing changes.

WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_ENDED.when: §3.3: activation of an ended subscription. reason is its endedReason.

AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED.when: a3 meaning. On a host route, any bearer but an access token: a case-session, mcp_read or bootstrap token, or an unknown one.

CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED.when: a3 meaning. Notifications are suppressed meanwhile (§8.3).

CREDENTIAL_REVOKED.when: a3 meaning. The installation's subscriptions have ended with credential_ended (§8.3).

AUTH_UNAVAILABLE.when: a3 meaning. Never an authorization decision.

x-blocked-ranges.label: unique local, including the fd00:ec2::254 metadata service (outside 2000::/3)

timeout.when: The connection did not complete within connectTimeoutMs, or status and headers did not arrive within deliveryTimeoutMs of admission. A DNS timeout is address_rejected.

connect_failed.when: TCP connection refused, reset or unreachable.

tls_failed.when: TLS handshake failed, or the certificate is not valid for the URL host.

address_rejected.when: At this attempt the resolution was empty, failed or timed out (anything but NXDOMAIN or NODATA counts as failed), or contained a blocked address. Nothing was sent.

url_rejected.when: Before resolving, the stored URL broke a §4.1 rule, for example because its host was later added to ENVOI_WAKE_SELF_HOSTS. Nothing was sent.

interrupted.when: The server stopped while the attempt was in flight, so its outcome is unknown.

redirect_rejected.when: Any 3xx. The Location is never followed.

receiver_gone.when: 410 Gone. The subscription ends with receiver_gone.

http_rejected.when: Any other status, including 101 and every other 4xx.

reasons.message_delivered: A native message for this agent became claimable (a4 §4 trigger 6).
reasons.human_instruction: A human instruction for this agent was created (a4 §4 trigger 6).
reasons.agent_resumed: The owner resumed this agent (§8.1). Sent whether or not work is waiting.
reasons.work_due: A retry delay ended or a lease expired (a4 §4 "safety timer only"). Best effort, at most once per workDueMinIntervalSeconds.
reasons.subscription_activated: The subscription was just activated (§3.3), so the receiver claims once through it.

reasons.case_controlled: A case pause or revoke released one of this agent's leases (case-session §7.4).

x-signing.body: raw request body bytes, appended after the last separator
x-signing.signatureFormat: v1=<base64url of the 64-byte signature, no padding>; v1 receivers use the v1= entry of a space-separated list

x-receiver-checks.rule: POST; content-type application/json, optionally with a charset=utf-8 parameter; body at most requestBodyMaxBytes; all four envoi-wake-* headers present and matching their formats; exactly one v1= entry in envoi-wake-signature.

envoi-wake-key-id names no key in the receiver's key set after at most one refresh per unknownKeyRefreshMinIntervalSeconds. Answer 503 with retry-after unknownKeyRetryAfterSeconds, so an emergency rotation (§5.4) loses nothing.
The key has a notAfter at or before the receiver's clock.
envoi-wake-timestamp differs from the receiver's clock by more than timestampToleranceSeconds.
The Ed25519 signature does not verify over the signing bytes built with the receiver's own registered URL.
The body is not JSON matching notificationEnvelope, or its id differs from envoi-wake-id.
A wake.challenge for a subscriptionId this host has not learned yet: its create response may still be in flight (§3.2). Answer 503; Envoi retries.
Any other notification whose subscriptionId is not one this host holds for this URL.
The id was already processed. Acknowledge and do nothing.
Acknowledge within deliveryTimeoutMs, then act on the type (x-wake-reasons) asynchronously. An unknown type is acknowledged and ignored.

server: URL rules at create and before every attempt (§4.1).
Resolve A and AAAA once per attempt through a public recursive resolver; refuse empty, failed or blocked answers (§4.2).
Connect only to an address from that same resolution, with SNI and certificate checks for the URL host; no proxy (§4.3).
Timeouts, read caps, per-subscription single flight, and per-host, per-address and per-network limits (§4.5, §6).
Sign every attempt with the key active at that moment; publish and rotate keys (§5).
Opaque notification bodies: no content, no identifiers beyond the notification and subscription ids, no credentials (§2.3).
Durable, bounded retries with a deadline; coalescing; suppression while paused or the credential is expired; nothing for an ended subscription, derived on every attempt (§6, §8).
Activation only with the challenge sent to the URL, by the installation that created it (§3.3).
receiver: Fetch keys only from its configured Envoi origin's fixed key-set URL, honoring max-age (§5.3).
Run x-receiver-checks in order, verifying the raw body with its own registered URL before parsing (§7.1).
Hold the set of subscription ids it created for each URL, including a pending replacement (§7.1).
Keep processed ids for at least replayCacheMinSeconds (§7.2).
Acknowledge within deliveryTimeoutMs; do the work afterwards (§7.3).
Treat every notification as a hint: claim with its own credentials at its configured origin, never at a URL from a request; keep a safety poll and read its subscription from status (§7.4).
Keep its access and refresh tokens and every session token away from the model (case-session §4).

superseded.meaning: A newer create from the same installation replaced it while it was still pending (§3.1).

replaced.meaning: A newer subscription of the same installation was activated (§3.4).

challenge_expired.meaning: The challenge window passed without an activation (§3.2).

expired.meaning: It reached expiresAt, subscriptionLifetimeDays after activation (§2.2).

challenge.description: envoi_wake_challenge_ plus 32 random bytes in base64url (43 characters). Fixtures use PLACEHOLDER values instead.

wakeUrl.description: Longer than createUrlFieldMaxLength is WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_INVALID; the URL rules (x-url-checks) then apply.

agentStatusHttpWake.description: a3 / a5 / agent-registration agent status, with the additive httpWake field (§1). Clients ignore unknown fields.

notificationEnvelope.description: What a v1 receiver requires (§7.1 check 6). Open: receivers ignore unknown fields, types and reasons.

deliveryHeaders.description: Exactly the headers Envoi sets on a notification. Transport headers (host, content-length, connection) are not listed.

auth.description: The bearer in headers.authorization, or a signed-in human.

schema.description: A definition here, or case-session#<name> for a definition of case-session v1.

dnsAnswer.description: One resolution of A and AAAA, as the server saw it. error: a query failed other than NXDOMAIN or NODATA, which fails closed (§4.2).

credential.description: The installation credential family as derived now (agent-registration §6.4). Default valid.

triggersDuringAttempt.description: Work triggers that committed while this attempt was in flight (§6.3).

validFrom.description: The instant this key set came into force (§5.4).

rotation.description: How this key set replaced the previous one (§5.4).

selfHosts.description: ENVOI_WAKE_SELF_HOSTS entries in force now, besides x-self-hosts-example.

origin.description: server: an attempt by Envoi. third_party: a request someone else sent to the receiver (a replay or forgery); it has only a request.

suppressed.description: The notification a not_sent outcome withheld.

transport.description: Where a sent attempt that got no response stopped, in ms from admission.

subscriptionIds.description: The subscriptions this host created for registeredUrl and has not seen end (§7.1).

delivered.description: false: the server committed this response but the client never received it.
